name: Bukhari completes Sahih al-Bukhari
summary: Muhammad al-Bukhari completes the Sahih, a critical compilation of some 7,275 hadith reports collected over sixteen years of travel and interrogation of authorities. The work becomes one of the two most authoritative Sunni hadith collections (alongside Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj's Sahih).

_quarry.structural_significance: Canonical Sunni hadith corpus that, alongside the Quran, becomes the second foundation of Islamic jurisprudence and theology.
